newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Tool Works says profits rise 23 percent.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Tool Works says profits rise 23 percent.

text.p: Illinois Tool Works Inc. said Wednesday its earnings rose 23 percent in the third quarter, helped by gains in its automotive and industrial components businesses.

The Glenview, Ill.-based maker of engineered components and industrial systems said its earnings rose to $122.8 million in the third quarter from $100 million a year ago. Earnings per share rose to 99 cents from 85 cents in 1995.
Revenues rose 18 percent to $1.24 billion from $1.05 billion in 1995.

The company said in its engineered components segment, third-quarter 1996 revenues were up 31 percent and operating income increased by 18 percent, due largely to its global automotive and industrial component businesses.
The company's industrial systems and consumables segment's revenues were up 2 percent and operating income increased 16 percent compared.
The company's stock was off 12.5 cents at $70.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
